outcome: postpartum urinary retention (PPUR) after cesarean delivery (CD)
cohort: 102 women who underwent cesarean delivery (34 with PPUR and 68 without)
finding: After matching for obstetric factors, use of postoperative narcotic analgesia was associated with an increased risk of PPUR.
mod_finding: This study focused specifically on postpartum urinary retention after cesarean delivery and did not compare it to other modes of delivery.
gest_age: Cases and controls differed in gestational age (P = 0.01).
